text:
Priya Nair: Need help coordinating a family-friendly interview visit for candidate Lucia Pereira (Sao Paulo -> London). Shes traveling with a 10-month-old and asked for a hotel with crib, a private lactation/pumping room with fridge access, and a daycare stipend for the interview day. Preferred in-office day: Mon next week 09:30-16:00 GMT.
Diego Alvarez: On the panel; I can do design 09:30-10:30. Also flag: Lucia is on-call at current job and asked whether we can arrange pager coverage for the interview day so she can be temporarily relieved.
Marta V: I can do coding 11:00-12:30. Prefer CoderPad and 15-min buffer. Also request a quiet room for pumping between sessions.
TravelOps: Hotel options: FamilySuite at RedLodge near office includes crib on request, fridge in room. We can book company-paid 1-night stay. Daycare partner: KidCare charge GBP 65 for up to 6 hours on-site. Stipend option: GBP 75 voucher instead. Which do you prefer?
Priya Nair: Lucia asked for in-room crib + on-site sitter for 4 hours during interviews. She prefers company-booked sitter over stipend. Approve booking if within budget.
Facilities-bot: We have a lactation room on 6th floor with fridge and nurse chair. I'll reserve 11:30-12:15 and 14:30-15:00 blocks. Also will leave a locked mini-fridge key with security.
Diego Alvarez: Regarding pager: Ops team needs official handover. Can we set a temporary rotation swing? I can take the on-call for Lucia's team 09:00-17:30 that day if team approves.
People-ops-bot: Handover policy reminder: On-call handovers require documented acceptance email from covering engineer and notification in runbook. Please confirm coverer and add to calendar.
Priya Nair: I spoke to Lucia: she will transfer pager if we can confirm coverer. Diego, can you confirm in email to ops?
Diego Alvarez: Confirmed, I'll email ops now and CC Lucia.
TravelOps: Hotel booked: RedLodge FamilySuite for Mon night. Sitter booked: KidCare booking KC-3345 for 09:15-13:30. Total est charge GBP 220. Receipt will be attached to event.
Marta V: Thanks. For the coding slot, can we add a 30-min quiet buffer immediately after for pumping/rest? That helps.
Priya Nair: Updated schedule: 09:30-10:30 design, 10:30-10:45 break, 11:00-12:30 coding, 12:30-13:30 lunch, 13:30-14:30 pair session, 14:30-15:00 HM wrap. Lactation room reserved 11:30-12:15 and 14:30-15:00. KidCare will pick up child at 09:10 and return at 13:30.
recruiter-bot: Draft calendar event: https://calendar.redwood.ai/events/1905550000  includes: hotel booking details, sitter confirmation KC-3345, lactation room reservation, on-call handover note. Invites pending until Lucia confirms travel docs.
Priya Nair: Lucia requested a short confirmation message to partner about bringing infant formula and any allergies for sitter. I'll include that in candidate message. Also will attach childcare waiver and LOA for any loaner device (not requested).
People-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: send candidate checklist 48h before travel and security to prepare a fridge key and parking permit.
TravelOps: Flight CO123 booked on company travel for Lucia and infant (infant as lap child). Note: passport for infant required at check-in. Please confirm infant passport number.
Priya Nair: Lucia sent infant passport number and requested vegetarian meal on flight. I've added notes. Sending confirmation to candidate now (excerpt): "Thanks Lucia  we've booked hotel with crib, KidCare for the interview window, reserved lactation room, and arranged on-call cover. Please bring infant passport and any formula. We'll send details 48h before travel."
Diego Alvarez: Emailed ops for pager handover; they replied with ACK and added runbook note.
Marta V: All good from my side.
recruiter-bot: Reminder set to send sitter contact 24h before event and lactation room access code 2h before.
Priya Nair: Closing thread  all bookings confirmed, awaiting travel check-in from candidate.
